_doc: Named Colab runs for colab/dcad.py. data: dataset names (Drive: dcad/datasets/<name>.tar); clean_blue_per_task: N clean sim demos per blue task (first N of sim_blue_v2c_24); phone: 'all' | 'blue' (phone_v2 replays, all tasks or blue only); ambient: true adds --ambient_t_min defaults.ambient_t_min (chosen from the small-policy sweep; null = not chosen yet, ambient runs refuse to start); train: extra train_smolvla.py args (added to defaults.train); probe: extra probe args; eval_k: episodes/task for the final eval (0 = skip); eval_steps: checkpoints to evaluate (default: the latest); init_from: continue another run's latest checkpoint (weights + optimizer). Add a new entry per experiment; never edit one that has run (its checkpoints on Drive were made with those args). eval_args: extra eval args for every eval of the run; eval_variants: [[tag, args], ...] evaluated per step (e.g. normal vs zero-noise sampling). probe_step: checkpoint(s) to probe (default all). Task-balanced sampling: train --balance tasks; dataset fractions: train --mix. Blue-only runs (B_*): no red/green data; eval_steps 'plateau' evaluates the earliest checkpoint after init_from whose blue probe accuracy is within 2/32 of the best (plateau.json). B2_*: 75% blue / 25% red/green (+recovery) per batch (--mix, blue split by frames), lr 1e-5 constant after a 200-step warmup, early stopping (early_stop: probe every 250 steps, blue only; stop when blue accuracy and nearest-cube distance plateau for 1k steps, cap 4k; checkpoint = best blue accuracy with nearest-cube distance <= 3.5 cm, selected.json).

C_rec4._note: C/C+N/C+N+amb from the recovery+decay checkpoint: +4k steps (cosine 1e-4 -> 2.5e-6), seen recovery data kept, task-balanced sampling, zero-noise eval: blue 50/task, seen 10/task

CN_rec4._note: C/C+N/C+N+amb from the recovery+decay checkpoint: +4k steps (cosine 1e-4 -> 2.5e-6), seen recovery data kept, task-balanced sampling, zero-noise eval: blue 50/task, seen 10/task

V0_30k_phonerec_decay3k._note: as V0_30k_rec_decay3k with the sim recovery data replaced by phone miss-and-correct clips (loss masked before the correction, ambient t_min); --mix gives them the sim recovery data's share of samples (36767 / 98344 = 0.37)

P_only._note: smolvla_base post-trained on the 38 successful blue phone replays only (sessions 3+4: 11/13/14 per blue task), naive loss, no sim/recovery data; cosine 1e-4 -> 2.5e-6 over 20k (VLM 1e-5), checkpoints every 2.5k; blue probe at every checkpoint; zero-noise blue eval (50/task) at 5k/10k/20k + the best probe step

S_only._note: control for P_only: the same recipe on the same number of clean sim blue episodes per task (11/13/14)

J_sim40._note: joint training from smolvla_base: red/green clean (600) + recovery (360) + 40 clean sim blue-orange demos (stand-in for the phone replays), mix 44/26/30% per batch; V0+recovery recipe in one run: constant 1e-4 (VLM 1e-5) to 30k, cosine to 2.5e-6 at 33k; checkpoints and all-cube probe every 2.5k; STOP if the blue probe is <= 0.40 at 15k; zero-noise eval at 15k/30k/33k: blue-orange 50, red/green 10 per task
